page.notes: Marginal notes read from the scan; the reference "Theodos[?]ij" and the note at mark i are partly soft. The numbers "I." and "II." are inline in the text, not headings. The lower left of the page carries the signature "Ee 3", and the digitiser watermark in the lower right is left out.
